# Nodsend

Nodsend is a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval API for AI agents.

## What it does
When an AI agent is about to take a consequential action, it sends a POST request to api.nodsend.com/v1/approvals. Nodsend delivers the request to a human via email, waits for their approval or rejection, and notifies the agent via webhook.

## API Base URL
https://api.nodsend.com

## Authentication
Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer nod_live_xxxx

## Core endpoint
POST /v1/approvals
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "action": "string",
  "summary": "string (max 500 chars)",
  "details": {},
  "channel": "email",
  "recipient": "human@example.com",
  "expires_in": "1h",
  "webhook_url": "https://your-agent/webhook"
}

## Documentation
https://nodsend.com/docs
